metrics.name: Account-Level MFA Enforcement
metrics.gotcha: AccountInfo.settings.enforce_twofactor is BOOLEAN. false = MFA not required at account level. AccountInfo fields: id, name, type, settings (enforce_twofactor, access_approval_expiry, use_account_custom_ns_by_default), created_on, legacy_flags.

metrics.name: Audit Log Entry Count
metrics.gotcha: AuditLogs[] fields include: id, when, actor, owner, action, metadata, newValue, oldValue, resource, interface. Count reflects the inspector's capture window — not all-time history.

metrics.name: Accepted Account Members Count
metrics.gotcha: Members[].status is STRING ('accepted'/'pending'). Do not use boolean. Pending members have not yet accepted their invitation to the account.

metrics.name: Total Account Member Count
metrics.gotcha: Members[] fields include: id, user (object with email, first_name, last_name, two_factor_authentication_enabled), roles (array of role objects), status (string: 'accepted'/'pending').

metrics.name: Role Count
metrics.gotcha: Roles[] fields include: id, name, description, permissions. These are account-level role definitions, not per-zone roles.

metrics.name: Active Zone Count
metrics.gotcha: Zones[].status is STRING. Values: 'active' (fully onboarded), 'pending' (nameservers not yet updated), 'paused' (Cloudflare disabled), 'deleted'. Demo zone has status='pending' so this query returns 0 on demo — expected behavior. On real customer zones should return the active zone count.

metrics.name: Zones List
metrics.jmesPathQuery: Zones[].{name: name, status: status, plan: plan.name}

metrics.name: Paused Zone Count
metrics.gotcha: Zones[].paused is BOOLEAN (true = Cloudflare protection bypassed, false = protection active). Use backtick-quoted boolean literal. Distinct from status='paused' — a zone can be active (status) but paused (protection off).

metrics.name: Total Zone Count
metrics.gotcha: Zones[] fields include: id, meta, name, plan, type, owner, paused (boolean), status (string: 'pending'/'active'/'paused'/'deleted'), account, created_on, modified_on, activated_on, name_servers, development_mode, original_dnshost, original_registrar, original_name_servers.
